channel.title: Installing new kernel
channel.description:
I am planning to install a more recent kernel following the Qubes docs: https://doc.qubes-os.org/en/r4.3/user/advanced-topics/managing-vm-kernels.html
The Kicksecure docs however mentions extra steps (under "Package Installation"):
https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/Kernel
I'm not sure how mandatory these extra steps are? Looking at them, I would guess that they are redundant after doing the steps in Qubes docs, but since it is saying "Once the Qubes VM kernel is functional, proceed with the following instructions." i thought I'd ask just in case.

item.title: Installing new kernel
item.dc:creator: arraybolt3
item.description:
I suspect that page is out of date. Simply upgrading the the Qubes kernel and rebooting dom0 is enough in my experience. The linux-image-* and linux-headers-* packages installed in the VM will have no effect unless you’re using an in-VM kernel, which is not (yet) supported.
